tagline: Carry three coloured prisms onto matching floor plates to bend a beam of light around the room and power the dark mainframe.
overview:
Prism Matrix is a small first-person light puzzle, one of a set of quick minigames built to test RedEngine. A red emitter in one corner shoots a pink beam across the floor to a red plate. Two more plates, green and blue, mark the next bends of the beam's path, and a dark box at the far end is the mainframe the beam should reach.

Near the start stand three loose prisms: red, green and blue. Pick one up (E), carry it onto the plate of its own colour and drop it. Each prism in place carries the beam one leg further: red first, then green, then blue. With all three seated the mainframe lights up white; keep the beam whole for two seconds to win.
story: A powered-down mainframe can only be woken by light. Three prisms lie on the floor of its chamber, and somewhere in the right arrangement is a path for the beam.
goal: Seat each prism on the plate of its colour so the beam reaches the mainframe, and keep it lit for 2 seconds: VICTORY. If three minutes pass first, the game ends in TIMEOUT.
rules: Pick up a prism by looking at it and pressing E; press E again to put it down.
The red prism belongs on the red plate, the green on the green plate, the blue on the blue plate. A prism on the wrong plate does nothing.
The beam goes on one leg at a time: red needs to be in place for the beam to reach green, red and green for it to reach blue, all three for it to reach the mainframe.
With all three seated the mainframe glows white. After 2 seconds lit, you win.

controls.action: Pick up or put down a prism

characters.name: The Prisms
characters.description: Three cylinders, red, green and blue, standing together near the start.

characters.name: The Emitter
characters.description: The red block in the corner. Its beam always reaches the red plate.

characters.name: The Plates
characters.description: Red, green and blue squares on the floor: the three corners of the beam's path.

characters.name: The Mainframe
characters.description: The dark box at the far end of the room. It glows white when the beam reaches it.

tips: Do it in colour order (red, green, blue): you can see each new leg of the beam appear.
Drop the prism while standing right on its plate; the prism has to end up inside the plate.
The panel at the top left shows OK1, OK2 and OK3 (each plate correct) and LIT (how long the mainframe has been lit).

gallery.caption: The room from above: the red emitter and its beam (bottom right), the green and blue plates, the prisms and the dark mainframe at the top.
Carrying the red prism toward the red plate.
Red in place: the beam now turns toward the green plate.
Green in place: the beam reaches across to the blue plate.
Blue in place: the beam reaches the mainframe.

Prism Matrix is one of ten small minigames added to RedEngineGames in a single commit on 2026-09-30 ("Add 10 unique data-driven minigames with feedback and launcher support"). They were built by an AI at the owner's request, as experiments that tested RedEngine side by side with a sister engine (each game's FEEDBACK.md compares the two), but the prompt that asked for them was given in a session that is not saved on this machine.
